newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy government presents Eurotax amendment.
newsitem.headline: Italy government presents Eurotax amendment.

text.p: Italy's centre-left government presented on Wednesday a budget amendment to its controversial "Euro-tax" proposals, raising the tax threshold for the self-employed to 15.2 million lire from 10 million.
The amendment left a proposed threshold for employees unchanged at 23 million lire.
The government also proposed various tax deductions, including work expenses for employees.
The one-off levy, to be paid next year, is designed to raise 12.5 trillion lire to help get Italy in shape to be a founder member of a single European currency in 1999.
